unit.why: One narrative chain: a Kovel hasid's report leads to the Maggid of Kozienice's account of his grandson, the future Mogielnica rebbe, praying so absorbed that he did not feel an iron nail pierce his forehead.

stories.start_quote: חסיד מפורסם אחד שהיה רגיל לנסוע
stories.summary_en: A hasid of the Kovel tzaddik, who later travelled to the Mogielnica rebbe, reports that he told the Kovel tzaddik of the Mogielnica rebbe's fame. The narrator's teacher relates that the Maggid of Kozienice praised this grandson: at age seven he prayed so absorbed that he did not feel an iron nail in the wall pierce his forehead, though blood ran down his face.

quotes: ולא חלי ולא מרגיש כלל מרוב דבקותו בתפלתו
tags.why: rapt absorption in prayer, insensible to pain
the point is to praise the young tzaddik's piety
